eps.o: Matthew goes from class clown to aspiring actor hoping to make it big. When he's cast on a new sitcom called "Friends," his life changes forever.
As his battle with addiction becomes more public, Matthew struggles to balance his career with a worsening cycle of rehab and relapse.
After surviving a harrowing medical scare, Matthew hopes a promising new drug treatment will aid his recovery, but it spirals instead to a fatal tragedy.
